name: ocr-bench-rubenstein-judge
description: A dataset of human judgments for evaluating OCR system outputs: judges compare or rate OCR transcriptions produced from scanned images/documents to assess transcription quality. The benchmark is intended to measure real-world OCR accuracy and perceptual quality beyond automatic string-matching metrics. It is useful for comparing OCR systems using human preference/quality judgments.
reputation: A niche dataset for OCR quality assessment with limited but relevant adoption in OCR/document-understanding research.
